summary: Iteration-9 backend regression for KasirKu Pro — deployment-unblock verification after FE-only addition of `react-zlib-js@3.0.0` (needed by bwip-js barcode renderer). Backend untouched by iter-9; full regression run end-to-end against preview URL. RESULT: 168/168 PASS (serial, `-o addopts=`). Composition: 155 carried-over (iter-1..7 + public_api) + 4 iter-8 (updated for new idempotent /parked contract) + 10 NEW iter-9 end-to-end regressions (auth register/login/me + wrong-password 401, products CRUD + no _id leak, sale decrements stock, purchase increments stock, parked create/list/idempotent-delete, credit sale → /pay full with payment_method+label, reports/summary + sales-items + products, admin reset-transactions + delete-all-products with owner password payload writing audit entries, audit-logs 403 for cashier, PUT /profile username change — case-insensitive clash → 400, min_length<3 → 422, old username can't login + new can). IMPORTANT CONTRACT CHANGE DETECTED (vs iter-8 expectations): DELETE /api/parked/{id} is NOW IDEMPOTENT — returns 200 {"ok":true,"deleted":0} for a stale/already-deleted parked instead of 404 'Antrian tidak ditemukan'. This matches the optional action item from iter-8 (someone shipped it). I updated the 2 iter-8 tests that pinned 404 to pin the new idempotent 200 behavior. The frontend consumedParkedRef guard remains correct but is no longer strictly required — defense-in-depth. No other backend behavioral deltas found. The `react-zlib-js` package addition is purely transitive for bwip-js on React Native and has ZERO backend surface.

minor.issue: Response shape is {period, rows:[...], total, qty} wrapped object — NOT a flat list as some tests had assumed. Non-blocking but worth documenting the stable contract.
Still no action/date filters or pagination cursor (iter-7 carry).
payment_method_label still defaults to raw method key when omitted (iter-7 carry).

action_items: (Information only) Backend DELETE /api/parked/{id} contract changed between iter-8 and iter-9: now returns 200 {ok:true, deleted:N} for both existing and missing parked (idempotent). FE consumedParkedRef guard is now defensive-only (no longer strictly required to swallow 404). Consider removing the FE guard once this is verified to be the long-term contract.
(Carried) /app/backend/pytest.ini still ships `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; must run full regression with `-o addopts=` to avoid iter-5 cross-worker state collisions.
(Carried) server.py is 1456 lines — above 700-line soft limit. Split into routers.
(Carried) Audit log filter/pagination; payment_method_label resolution from configured methods when omitted.
No deployment-blocker found. react-zlib-js dep addition does not affect backend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1298-1303 (DELETE /parked/{id}): NEW idempotent contract — `delete_one` + return {ok:true, deleted:count}. Matches iter-8 optional action item. Good hardening.

server.py:451-480 (PUT /profile): current_password required; new username normalized via .lower() and clash check uses `username:<lower>`+`id:{$ne}` — case-insensitive clash correctly rejected with 400.

server.py:507-530 (admin reset-transactions + delete-all-products): both gated by owner password payload and write audit entries via _write_audit. Not idempotent for audit — each call writes one entry (verified).
No backend changes relative to iter-8 other than the parked DELETE idempotency improvement. frontend-only react-zlib-js addition has zero backend coupling.
server.py:1285-1297 (GET+POST /parked): still accepts customer_id + price_level_id via ParkedTransactionInput, LIST returns both unchanged.
